title: Equation Discovery Engine: System Overview
description: Signature-original system overview for the proposed Equation Discovery Engine system (entry 421).
body:
Equation Discovery Engine (entry 421 of the Ultimate Apex God-Mode Engineering System: Hybrid Physics & Mathematics Discovery) is a Signature-original proposed capability. Searches experimental data for candidate mathematical relationships. Every entry in this system is built with the mix-and-match formula — one objective flows through six layers: intelligence, knowledge, creation, experiment, verification, and evolution.

It takes one objective — for example, discovering the governing equation behind a new experimental dataset — and builds the complete discovery ecosystem around it.

A proposed capability remains a proposal until implemented and validated. Feasibility tier for this entry: experimentally-supported.
